purpose: Numerical validation only. Do not alter the latent-state model, q offsets, strata, parameter bounds, likelihood or interpretation.
outputs: sigma_hat by node count for all clusters
sigma_hat by node count for dry-route-silent clusters
relative deviation of sigma_hat from the 60-node value
pass_rule: For both strata, the 20-node sigma estimate differs from the 60-node estimate by <= 2% and the 40-node estimate differs by <= 0.5%.
interpretation: PASS supports numerical stability of the existing point estimate only. It does not upgrade evidential status or validate cluster-independence assumptions for the profile-likelihood interval.
anti_tuning: Do not change node counts after readback.
Do not change parameter bounds, q, strata or optimizer.
If convergence fails, demote the latent-state magnitude model rather than retuning it.
